check.connection_churn.fix.mysql_thread_: Pool connections in the application. Until then, a larger thread cache lets new connections reuse threads: {how}
check.connection_churn.fix.postgres: Pool connections in the application (every mainstream driver has a pool), or put PgBouncer in front in transaction mode so thousands of clients share a few dozen server connections.
check.connection_churn.fix.sqlite: Keep one connection open per worker instead of opening the file for each request.
check.connection_churn.fix.yugabyte: Reuse connections through the application pool or YSQL Connection Manager; compare connection setup latency and client/backend counts before changing pool sizes.

check.heavy_query.fix.idle.locks: Keep those transactions short: commit sooner, and don't wait for a user or another service inside a transaction. An index or a rewrite of this statement won't shorten the wait.

check.heavy_query.fix.idle.sleep: Find who sends it (a health check, a test, a retry loop with a back-off) and whether the pause belongs in the database at all: while it sleeps it holds a connection, and any locks its transaction took.
